name: Data Engineering
certifications: Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700)

beginner.summary: For analysts, developers and graduates moving into data engineering. Covers the role, Python and SQL for data, file formats, data modelling, building batch ETL pipelines, loading databases, scheduling, data quality, a first look at Spark, Airflow and cloud storage, ending with a working end-to-end pipeline.
prerequisites: Basic Python: variables, loops, functions and lists
Basic SQL: SELECT, WHERE, JOIN and GROUP BY
Comfortable with a terminal and installing software
outcomes: Build batch pipelines that extract, clean, transform and load data
Choose file formats and model data for analytics
Schedule pipelines and check data quality
Use Spark and Airflow for simple jobs

days.topic: Data Engineering Overview and Environment Setup
subtopics: What data engineers do and how the role differs from analysts and data scientists
The data lifecycle: sources, ingestion, storage, transformation, serving
Data warehouse, data lake and lakehouse in plain terms
Installing Python, VS Code, Git and Docker
days.lab_task: Set up the course environment with PostgreSQL in Docker and a Python project in Git, and draw the data flow for the course project from source files to a reporting table.
days.deliverable: Working environment, Git repository and data flow diagram
checks: Sources, storage, transformations and outputs are labelled
objectives: Set up a data engineering environment

subtopics: Reading and writing files with pathlib
Functions and modules for pipeline steps
days.lab_task: Write a Python script that reads a folder of daily CSV order files, validates each row, writes valid rows to one JSON file and bad rows with reasons to a rejects file, with logging.
days.deliverable: Script, output files and log
checks: Valid and rejected counts match the answer sheet
Include a row with a negative amount
Row appears in the rejects file with the reason
Run with a missing folder argument

days.lab_task: Clean the orders data with pandas, join it to customers and products, compute daily revenue by region and save the result, and check totals against a reference.
days.deliverable: Notebook or script and result file
checks: Compare revenue totals with the reference

days.lab_task: Load the cleaned orders into PostgreSQL, write SQL for revenue by month with running totals, upsert a corrected batch and run it inside a transaction.
days.deliverable: SQL scripts and query results
checks: Last value equals the yearly total

days.topic: File Formats: CSV, JSON, Parquet and Avro
days.lab_task: Save the same 5 million rows as CSV, JSON and Parquet, compare file sizes and read times, query one column from each and write a partitioned Parquet dataset by date.
days.deliverable: Comparison table and partitioned dataset
checks: Much faster than reading the CSV
Only that partition's files are read

days.lab_task: Design a star schema for the sales data with a fact table at order line grain and customer, product and date dimensions, then create and load it.
days.deliverable: Model diagram, DDL and loaded tables
checks: Total revenue from the fact table

days.lab_task: Build an incremental pipeline that loads only new orders since the last run using a watermark, stages them, merges into the fact table and can be re-run safely.
days.deliverable: Pipeline code and run logs for three runs
checks: Run twice with no new data

days.topic: Ingesting Data from APIs and Databases
subtopics: Authentication with API keys and tokens
days.lab_task: Ingest all pages from a public test API with retries and rate limiting, store the raw JSON by date, and extract changed customers from a source database since the last run.
days.deliverable: Ingestion scripts, raw files and run logs
checks: Return HTTP 429 from the test server
None found; they come from environment variables

subtopics: Failing a pipeline on bad data
days.lab_task: Add quality checks for nulls, duplicates, valid ranges, foreign keys and freshness to the pipeline, quarantine failing rows and stop the load when too many fail.
days.deliverable: Check suite, quarantine table and quality report
checks: Load a file with duplicate order IDs
Load a file where 20 percent of rows fail
Pipeline stops with a clear error
Run the freshness check on old data

subtopics: Running scripts on a schedule with cron
days.lab_task: Schedule the pipeline with cron, record each run in a run history table, send an alert email on failure and backfill one missed week.
days.deliverable: Cron configuration, run history and backfill log
checks: Run recorded with status and row counts

days.lab_task: Rebuild the pipeline as an Airflow DAG with extract, quality, load and report tasks, retries and a connection to PostgreSQL, and backfill one month.
days.deliverable: DAG code, UI screenshots and backfill run
checks: Make the extract task fail once

days.lab_task: Process 50 million order rows with PySpark: filter, join with products, aggregate revenue by category and day, write partitioned Parquet and inspect the job in the Spark UI.
days.deliverable: PySpark script, output dataset and Spark UI screenshots
checks: Compare results with a pandas run on a sample
Explain why nothing ran until write

subtopics: Object storage: S3, ADLS and GCS
Reading and writing from Python and Spark
tools: AWS S3 or Azure Data Lake Storage
days.lab_task: Create a data lake with raw, clean and curated zones in MinIO or S3, move the pipeline's files through the zones and set a lifecycle rule for raw data.
days.deliverable: Lake structure, pipeline changes and lifecycle rule
checks: Files appear in raw, clean and curated paths
Raw data expires after the set days

days.lab_task: Load the star schema into DuckDB and a cloud warehouse trial with COPY, implement a type 2 customer dimension and compare query speed with PostgreSQL.
days.deliverable: Load scripts, dimension history and timing comparison
checks: Change a customer's city and reload
New dimension row with validity dates
Run the revenue query on PostgreSQL and DuckDB

days.topic: Transformations in SQL with dbt Essentials
days.lab_task: Move the warehouse transformations into a dbt project with sources, staging and mart models, tests for keys and relationships, and generated documentation.
days.deliverable: dbt project, test results and documentation site
checks: Insert a duplicate key in the source
Lineage graph shows sources to marts

days.lab_task: Package the pipeline as a Docker image, run it with PostgreSQL and Airflow in Docker Compose and push the image to a registry.
days.deliverable: Dockerfile, Compose file and registry image
checks: Run the container with docker run

subtopics: Integration tests with a database container
days.lab_task: Write unit tests for the transformation functions, an integration test that runs the pipeline against a PostgreSQL container and a CI workflow that runs them on every push.
days.deliverable: Test suite and CI run

days.topic: Logging, Monitoring and Alerting for Pipelines
days.lab_task: Add structured logs and run metrics to the pipeline, build a pipeline health dashboard, set a freshness SLA alert and write a runbook for the most common failure.
days.deliverable: Logging set-up, dashboard, alert and runbook
checks: Delay the data by a day
Rows, duration and status per run shown
Follow the runbook for the failure

subtopics: Encryption at rest and in transit
India's DPDP Act and GDPR in brief
days.lab_task: Classify the columns in the customer data, mask emails and phone numbers in the curated zone, create read-only analyst roles and move credentials to a secret manager.
days.deliverable: Classification sheet, masked data, roles and secret configuration
checks: Try to write as an analyst

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: End-to-End Sales Data Pipeline
subtopics: Ingestion from files and an API
days.lab_task: Build a containerised pipeline that ingests sales files and an API, loads a star schema incrementally with dbt, runs in Airflow with quality checks, tests and alerts, then demo it.
days.deliverable: Repository, Airflow DAG, dbt project, test report and a 10-minute demo
checks: Run the DAG for three days of data
Fact table totals match the sources
Quality check stops the load and alerts
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one pipeline
Prove correctness with checks and tests

intermediate.summary: For data engineers who have built batch pipelines. Covers lakehouse architecture, Spark in depth, Delta Lake and table formats, production Airflow and dbt, streaming with Kafka and Spark, change data capture, cloud data platforms, data quality at scale, CI/CD, governance and cost.
prerequisites: Has built batch pipelines with Python and SQL
Has used Airflow or another orchestrator
Knows the basics of Spark and data modelling
outcomes: Design lakehouse platforms and build pipelines with Spark and Delta Lake
Build streaming and change data capture pipelines
Run production orchestration, dbt and data quality
Deploy pipelines on a cloud data platform with CI/CD

days.topic: Data Platform Architecture: Warehouse, Lake and Lakehouse
subtopics: Batch and streaming in one platform
Reference architectures on AWS, Azure and GCP
tools: Databricks or Microsoft Fabric reference architectures
days.lab_task: Design a lakehouse for a retail company with batch and streaming sources, medallion layers, serving to BI and ML, and record the main tool decisions.
days.deliverable: Architecture diagram and decision records
checks: Each layer has a purpose and quality rules

subtopics: Complex types: arrays, maps and structs
days.lab_task: Transform nested clickstream JSON into session tables with explode, windows and joins, replace a slow Python UDF with built-in functions and compare runtimes.
days.deliverable: Spark job, output tables and timing comparison
checks: Read a file with bad records
Bad records captured in a separate path

days.lab_task: Tune a slow job that joins 200 million events to customers: fix skew, use a broadcast join, set partitions and compact small files, and show the runtime drop.
days.deliverable: Plans and Spark UI evidence before and after, and timings
checks: Find the skewed stage in the Spark UI
Small files compacted to the target size

days.topic: Delta Lake and Open Table Formats
days.lab_task: Convert the silver tables to Delta, upsert daily changes with MERGE, restore yesterday's version with time travel, evolve the schema and optimise the table.
days.deliverable: Delta tables, MERGE job and history output
checks: Run MERGE with updates and inserts
Write a column of the wrong type
objectives: Build reliable tables on a lake
Use time travel and schema evolution

days.lab_task: Refactor the DAG with the TaskFlow API, map tasks over a list of source systems, trigger downstream DAGs on dataset updates and add DAG tests.
days.deliverable: DAG code, tests and run screenshots
checks: Add a new source to the list
A task is created for it with no code change

days.topic: Advanced dbt: Incremental Models, Macros and Packages
subtopics: Incremental strategies: append, merge, insert overwrite
days.lab_task: Convert the fact model to incremental merge, add a snapshot for products, write a macro for currency conversion, add contracts and set up slim CI.
days.deliverable: dbt project changes and CI results
checks: Second run processes only new rows
Open a pull request touching one model
Slim CI builds only changed models

days.topic: Managed Ingestion Tools: Airbyte, Fivetran and Azure Data Factory
subtopics: Sync modes: full refresh, incremental, CDC
days.lab_task: Ingest a SaaS source and a PostgreSQL source with Airbyte using incremental sync, add a new column at the source, and compare effort and cost with the custom ingestion scripts.
days.deliverable: Connector configuration, sync logs and comparison
checks: Run an incremental sync after new rows arrive
Add a column at the source
Column appears in the destination as configured
objectives: Decide when to build or buy

days.topic: Data Modelling at Scale: Data Vault, Wide Tables and Semantic Layers
subtopics: Data Vault hubs, links and satellites
days.lab_task: Model the customer and order domain as a Data Vault in dbt, build a wide gold table from it and define three metrics in a semantic layer, then compare query effort for analysts.
days.deliverable: Data Vault models, gold table, metric definitions and comparison
checks: New satellite row with load date
Query a metric through the semantic layer
Gold table query is simpler with the same result
objectives: Apply Data Vault and wide-table modelling

days.lab_task: Produce order events with an Avro schema, consume them in a group of three consumers, add a sink connector to the lake and watch consumer lag under load.
days.deliverable: Producer and consumer code, connector configuration and lag graph
checks: Partitions are rebalanced to the others
Send an event that breaks the schema

days.topic: Stream Processing with Spark Structured Streaming
days.lab_task: Build a streaming job that reads orders from Kafka, computes revenue per five-minute window with a watermark, writes to Delta and recovers from a restart.
days.deliverable: Streaming job, output table and restart test
checks: Send late events within the watermark
Continues from the checkpoint without duplicates

days.lab_task: Capture inserts, updates and deletes from a PostgreSQL source with Debezium, apply them to a Delta table and prove the lake matches the source.
days.deliverable: CDC configuration, apply job and reconciliation
checks: Update a row in the source
Change appears in the lake within a minute
Row is deleted or marked deleted as designed

days.topic: Cloud Data Platforms: Databricks, Microsoft Fabric and AWS Glue
subtopics: Azure Data Factory and Fabric pipelines
days.lab_task: Run the silver-to-gold job on two managed platforms as scheduled jobs, compare set-up effort, runtime and cost, and recommend one for the company.
days.deliverable: Two implementations and a comparison report
checks: Run the job on both platforms

days.topic: Cloud Data Warehouses: Snowflake and BigQuery
days.lab_task: Load the gold tables into Snowflake or BigQuery, add clustering, query semi-structured data, clone a database for testing and set a cost monitor.
days.deliverable: Load scripts, query results and cost settings
checks: Query with and without clustering on date

days.topic: Data Quality and Observability at Scale
subtopics: Great Expectations or Soda in pipelines
days.lab_task: Add expectation suites to bronze, silver and gold, monitor volume anomalies and schema changes, and use lineage to find every dashboard affected by a bad source.
days.deliverable: Expectation suites, monitors and impact analysis
checks: Drop a column in the source
Use lineage to find affected assets
All downstream tables and dashboards listed

days.topic: Infrastructure as Code for Data Platforms
subtopics: Terraform for storage, compute and warehouses
days.lab_task: Define the lake storage, a warehouse, roles and a job cluster in Terraform for dev and prod, apply it through a pipeline and detect a manual change.
days.deliverable: Terraform modules, plans and drift report

subtopics: Unit and integration tests in CI
days.lab_task: Build a pipeline that lints, tests and deploys the dbt project and Spark jobs to dev, shows a data diff on a pull request and promotes to prod with approval.
days.deliverable: Workflow files and a release record
checks: Push SQL that breaks the lint rules
Open a pull request that changes a model

days.topic: Data Governance, Catalogues and Access Control
days.lab_task: Register the gold tables in a catalogue with owners and descriptions, tag personal data, add row-level security by region and review the access audit log.
days.deliverable: Catalogue entries, policies and audit review
checks: Only that region's rows are returned
Search the catalogue for personal data
Queries on sensitive tables are recorded
objectives: Control access by row and column

days.topic: Batch and Streaming Serving for BI and Applications
days.lab_task: Serve gold data to a BI dashboard through a semantic model and to an application through a small API with caching, and measure freshness and query time.
days.deliverable: Dashboard, API and measurements
checks: Second call served from the cache
objectives: Serve data to BI and apps

days.lab_task: Analyse a month of platform usage, find the five most expensive jobs and queries, cut their cost and build a cost dashboard by team.
days.deliverable: Cost analysis, changes and dashboard
checks: Rank the top five cost items
Combined cost at least 30 percent lower

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Lakehouse with Batch and Streaming Pipelines
days.lab_task: Build a lakehouse that ingests a database by CDC and events by Kafka, transforms through medallion layers with Spark and dbt, enforces quality and access rules, deploys by CI/CD and serves a dashboard, then present it.
days.deliverable: Repositories, pipeline runs, quality reports, dashboard and a 15-minute demo
checks: Change reaches the gold table and dashboard within the target time
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one platform

advanced.summary: For senior data engineers and data architects. Covers platform architecture at scale, data mesh and data products, Spark and table format internals, real-time systems with Flink, data contracts, metadata and lineage, privacy engineering, ML and AI data pipelines, reliability, migration from legacy platforms and data strategy.
prerequisites: Has run production data pipelines on a cloud platform
Knows Spark, a table format, streaming and orchestration
Leads design work on a data team
outcomes: Architect data platforms and data products for many teams
Tune engines and table formats at scale
Build real-time, ML and AI data systems
Govern, secure and run data platforms reliably and cost-effectively

days.lab_task: Design the target data platform for a group with ten business units and three regions, covering isolation, self-service, residency and disaster recovery, and record the decisions.
days.deliverable: Target architecture, decision records and requirements
checks: Data stays in its required region
RPO and RTO stated per tier

days.lab_task: Define three data products for sales, inventory and customer domains with owners, interfaces, service levels and quality scores, publish them and consume one in another domain.
days.deliverable: Product definitions, published products and a consumer example
checks: Discoverable with owner, schema and service level
Works through the published interface only

days.lab_task: Write contracts for two event streams and one table, enforce them in CI and at ingestion, and run a breaking change through a versioned migration.
days.deliverable: Contracts, CI checks and migration record
checks: Push a producer change that breaks the contract

days.lab_task: Analyse the physical plans of three heavy jobs, fix spills and missed pruning, size clusters from measurements and benchmark the improvements.
days.deliverable: Plan analysis, fixes, sizing and benchmark results
checks: Find a spill in the Spark UI

days.topic: Table Format Internals: Delta Lake and Apache Iceberg at Scale
days.lab_task: Run concurrent writers on one table, compare clustering strategies on query time, set up maintenance jobs and read the same table from Spark and Trino.
days.deliverable: Experiment results, maintenance jobs and interoperability demo
checks: Query time and files scanned recorded

days.topic: Real-Time Data Systems with Apache Flink
days.lab_task: Build a Flink job that detects payment fraud patterns in real time with keyed state, exactly-once writes to Kafka and a savepoint upgrade without data loss.
days.deliverable: Flink job, test results and upgrade record
checks: Job recovers from the checkpoint with no duplicates

subtopics: ClickHouse, Apache Druid and Apache Pinot
days.lab_task: Stream events into ClickHouse with materialised rollups, serve a sub-second dashboard and compare it with querying the lakehouse.
days.deliverable: Ingestion set-up, dashboard and comparison

days.topic: Distributed Query Engines and Federation with Trino
subtopics: Connectors for lakes, databases and warehouses
days.lab_task: Run Trino over an Iceberg lake, PostgreSQL and Kafka, write a federated report query, tune pushdown, set resource groups for two teams and compare cost with copying the data.
days.deliverable: Trino configuration, queries, plans and comparison
checks: Run two teams' heavy queries together
Resource groups limit each team as configured

days.lab_task: Collect lineage from Airflow, Spark and dbt into one catalogue, trace column-level lineage for a KPI and automate alerts to owners of affected products.
days.deliverable: Lineage set-up, KPI lineage and automated alerts
checks: Owners of affected products are alerted

subtopics: Right to erasure in lakes and warehouses
days.lab_task: Tokenise personal identifiers at ingestion, enforce purpose-based access, carry out an erasure request across bronze to gold with table history, and pass an audit checklist.
days.deliverable: Tokenisation set-up, access policies, erasure record and audit checklist
checks: Person's data gone from every layer and from history after vacuum

days.lab_task: Build point-in-time correct features for a churn model in a feature store, serve them online and offline, and show that a naive join leaks future data.
days.deliverable: Feature pipelines, feature store set-up and leakage demonstration
checks: Read the same feature online and offline

days.lab_task: Build a pipeline that parses 100,000 documents, chunks and embeds only changed ones, stores vectors with permissions and lineage, and reports embedding cost.
days.deliverable: Pipeline, vector index and cost report

subtopics: Disaster recovery for lakes and warehouses
days.lab_task: Define SLOs for three data products, inject failures in sources and compute, replay a week of data within the recovery target and run a post-incident review.
days.deliverable: SLO definitions, chaos test results, replay record and review
checks: Completed within the recovery target with correct totals

subtopics: Assessing Hadoop, Informatica and on-premise warehouses
days.lab_task: Plan the migration of a provided Informatica and Hadoop estate, convert three jobs to Spark and dbt, validate outputs in a parallel run and write the cut-over plan.
days.deliverable: Migration plan, converted jobs, validation report and cut-over plan
checks: Row counts and checksums match the legacy outputs

days.topic: DataOps and Platform Engineering for Data Teams
days.lab_task: Build a golden path that gives a new domain team a repository, CI/CD, orchestration and catalogue entries for a new data product in under an hour, and measure it with a pilot team.
days.deliverable: Golden path, templates and pilot measurements
checks: Working product skeleton in under one hour
Tests, quality checks and lineage included

days.topic: Performance and Cost at Petabyte Scale
days.lab_task: Analyse a petabyte-scale workload profile, redesign layouts and scheduling for the top workloads and build a cost model that shows savings and commitments.
days.deliverable: Workload analysis, redesign and cost model

subtopics: Data sharing across clouds: Delta Sharing, Snowflake sharing
days.lab_task: Share a gold table from one cloud to a consumer in another with Delta Sharing, query across clouds with Trino and measure egress cost and latency.
days.deliverable: Sharing set-up, federated queries and measurements
checks: Read the shared table from the other cloud

days.lab_task: Resolve four injected incidents (a double load, a stuck skewed job, schema drift and a corrupt table version), restore correct data and write runbooks.
days.deliverable: Incident records, fixes and runbooks
checks: Correct version restored with time travel
Write a runbook for schema drift

days.lab_task: Review two proposed data platform designs from a case study, find risks, write decision records and present a data strategy and roadmap to a mock leadership team.
days.deliverable: Review notes, decision records, strategy and presentation

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Governed Data Platform with Real-Time and AI Products
days.lab_task: Deliver a platform with three contracted data products, real-time fraud detection, a feature store and an AI document pipeline, with lineage, privacy controls, SLOs and a cost model, then present it to a mock board.
days.deliverable: Platform repositories, SLO dashboards, privacy evidence, cost model and a 20-minute presentation
checks: SLO alert fires and replay recovers within the target
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
Prove reliability, privacy and cost control
